recs.stt: We have an epidemic of bad posture
The $100B per year back pain industry is mostly a hoax
recs.x:
I don't know if Sarno got everything right, but typing this comment without pain proves to me that he is on to something.

Don't suffer for years like I did! If you are interested, I would recommend watching this 20/20 segment with Dr. Sarno: [link] (13m35s). If you search for "RSI" on Hacker News, there are some great threads in which Sarno's theory is discussed.
